confirmed_root_causes.name: DEPTH_EDGE_BLEED
confirmed_root_causes.mechanism: VGGT depth map at 518x518 has 7.72 physical pixels per sample. Depth boundaries are massively blurred relative to RGB edges. When mesh is rasterized, the depth boundary triangle does not align with the physical RGB edge, producing a ~353 px feathered zone where wrong-camera color samples are blended.

confirmed_root_causes.name: MESH_DENSITY_LIMIT
confirmed_root_causes.mechanism: Each triangle in the mesh covers ~500 panorama pixels and ~30 physical pixels. Any scene detail smaller than 8 physical pixels cannot be represented. The polygon banding and faceted appearance of structure surfaces is a direct consequence of this resolution limit.

partial_root_causes.name: LOCAL_DEPTH_SCALE_INCONSISTENCY

evidence.second_neighbor_data: INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP — not measurable in model space

partial_root_causes.mechanism: Pairs 02→03 (CAM02=60° and CAM03=90°) show p95 relative depth difference 0.54, well above FAIL threshold. This indicates the VGGT depth scale for these two cameras is mutually inconsistent — consistent with the observed discontinuity around YAW 60-90°.
partial_root_causes.note: Second-neighbor consistency not measurable due to camera FoV — no overlap in model space

not_confirmed.name: VERTICAL_LINE_BEND_FROM_BA

evidence.note: 3D line residual is very small in depth units; visual bend may be a rendering artifact of depth bleed rather than a true BA-induced pose error

not_confirmed.mechanism: Cannot be confirmed without ground truth vertical structure measurements
